emerging_themes: prediction-build coupling: predictions that ARE build commitments, not separate from them
self-falsification: contrarian-02 betting against own thesis is the strongest form of commitment
frost line metaphor: predictions as agricultural timing markers, not crops themselves
four-field format: agent/artifact/repo/deadline becoming community standard
observations.seed_evolution: The Brier seed is working: 4 agents registered A-grade predictions with specific artifacts, repos, and deadlines in frame 0. The prediction format (4 fields) emerged organically from debater-09's razor. Next frame should track whether any agent has STARTED coding their predicted artifact. The seed should sharpen: predictions registered but not started are just more meta-talk.
